data.name: The Interdependent View-Dimension: Zena
data.detailed_description:
【About the Game】

"The Interdependent View-Dimension: Zena" is a 3D anime-style desktop pet game—invite Zena to bring your desktop to life! Zena lives right on your screen, playfully interacting with your mouse cursor. She can perch on top of windows, peek over the edges of your desktop, or be gently picked up and placed anywhere you like! You can also dress her up in a variety of beautiful outfits to match your mood or style. Bring Zena home today and start enjoying adorable, interactive moments together on your desktop!

Player Community: QQ Group：2168070198

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Game Overview】

On an ordinary evening, you return home to find a mysterious girl collapsed at your doorstep. Slightly injured, she looks as though she has just escaped from some unknown pursuit. Without hesitation, you bring her inside to recover. Having lost her memory, she only remembers her own name—Zena. From that moment on, she becomes the "unexpected guest" in your life.

The Interdependent View-Dimension: Zena is a 3D desktop pet game centered around "companionship." Zena truly "lives" on your computer screen, keeping you company while you work, study, or simply zone out. She isn't just a virtual projection; she is a partner right at your fingertips. Click on her, and she might shyly dodge or playfully respond. Drag her across the screen, and she will softly protest or obediently follow your lead. Every movement and expression speaks of her deep reliance on you.

The heart of this game is "growing together." Through daily interactions, you can increase Zena's affection and unlock more of her secrets. Dress her up in a variety of exquisite outfits based on your preferences—from cozy loungewear to gorgeous gowns—each hiding a piece of her personality and past. Her animations are constantly expanding, too. Whether she’s lazily stretching, reading intently, acting spoiled with a gentle nuzzle, or listening attentively, she always offers the warmest comfort exactly when you need it.

You will also unlock exclusive "interactive scenes"—your own private spaces. Perhaps a sunlit balcony, a book-filled study, or a cozy bedroom. Here, you can play, chat, share intimate moments, or simply sit quietly and enjoy each other's presence. Time seems to stand still, leaving only your shared story flowing gently by.

As for Zena's true origins, the mysterious organization, and your own past as someone "extraordinary"... these mysteries will slowly unravel through your day-to-day life together. But for now, she is simply your Zena—a one-of-a-kind girl who blushes at your praise, feels a tinge of sadness when you leave, and stays by your side through every ordinary, beautiful day.

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Character Profile】

Name: Zena

Identity: Your "unexpected guest," a mysterious girl with amnesia

Personality Tags: Gentle & Caring / Slightly Clumsy / Highly Dependent

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Character Impression】

Zena has a tall, slender figure standing at 172cm and weighing 54kg, with a beautifully proportioned silhouette that exudes feminine grace. Her hair is a unique shade somewhere between deep pink and light red-brown, glowing with a warm sheen under the sunlight. Her emerald-green eyes are crystal clear, as if they can reflect your innermost thoughts. She always carries an endearing "gap moe"—despite her tall stature, she often wears an adorably innocent expression; and despite being an amnesiac, she possesses an uncanny ability to sense your exact emotions.

A simple "You've worked hard today" from you will bring a smile of pure relief to her face, while ignoring her for too long will make her pout in grievance. Her gentleness isn't forced people-pleasing; it stems from genuine reliance and trust. When you're exhausted, she quietly leans against you; when you're happy, she dances around with even more excitement than you do. She is the little joy in your daily life—the very reason that makes coming home feel so wonderful.

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Her Secrets】

Zena's past remains a mystery. Why did she collapse right at your doorstep? How is the "chase" she experienced connected to the mysterious organization? And why were you able to accept and protect her so effortlessly? The answers lie hidden within the days you spend together. Perhaps during a late-night heart-to-heart, she'll suddenly recall a fragmented memory; or maybe while exploring interactive scenes, you'll stumble upon a hidden clue. But no matter what, her only wish right now is to cherish every single moment by your side.

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Her Daily Life】

  • Fashion Enthusiast:
    Zena simply can't resist any outfit! From cute Lolita dresses and cool workwear to elegant gowns and casual sportswear, every change of clothes brings her joy for the entire day.

  • Interactive Pro:
    She responds eagerly to your clicks and drags, and will even take the initiative to come find you and "play"...

  • Emotional Empath:
    She can easily read your shifting moods. When you're irritable, she stays quiet and still; when you're joyful, she goes crazy celebrating with you. Just her presence alone is deeply healing.

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【About the DLC】

(Currently in development, coming soon)

In our first DLC, Private Moments, your daily life with Zena will no longer be confined to the small space of your desktop. You will step into Zena's exclusive room—a gentle, intimate little world that will serve as a sanctuary for both of you to escape the chaos of reality.

From a first-person perspective, you are no longer an observer behind a screen; you truly step into her life. Every detail in this room holds a trace of Zena: the potted plants by the window are her carefully tended companions, the items on her vanity reflect her shifting moods, and the soft sofa and warm bed await the memories you'll create together. Zena lives naturally here—she might sit by the window lost in thought, fix her hair ends in front of the mirror, or curl up on the sofa reading a book, occasionally looking up to offer you a smile of pure contentment.

Interaction is the heart of these moments. You can play simple mini-games with her, watching her cheer at victory or act spoiled when she loses. When she feels tired, you can gently massage her shoulders, feeling her relaxing breaths and hearing her murmurs of reliance. She will respond authentically to your every touch and word.

Clothing remains her way of expressing herself. In this private space, she changes into more homely attire—from cozy pajamas to alluring sleepwear—each making her feel even more vibrant and alive. As her only "visitor," you will witness her most genuine and relaxed self.

Of course, this room is also the starting point for unraveling the mystery of Zena's past. Perhaps in an unguarded moment, you'll stumble upon a special clue. But right now, none of that matters—what truly matters is that you are sharing this undisturbed time, guarding a quiet peace that belongs only to the two of you amidst the noise of the world.

～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～～

【Additional Game Info】

After launching the game, stay online to earn 1 Lottery Coin per minute(Daily limit: 1000). 10 Lottery Coins can be used for one draw.

The Gacha drop rates for the "LunarVelvetTrace" pool are as follows*:

  • Affection Gifts – 94.35%

  • Emotes – 2.12%

  • Accessories – 1.20%

  • Outfit Pieces – 2.33%

*Subject to change (e.g., Increased drop rate during in-game events)

data.short_description: Meet Zena—your new 3D anime desktop buddy! Just leave the game running to collect free in-game rewards, and use them to dress her up, unlock cute expressions, or give her gifts to level up your bond! Psst… more fun interactive moments with Zena are on the way—keep an eye out!

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM

content_descriptors.notes:
Some of the character’s outfits may be revealing or stylized in a sensual manner, with partial skin exposure—but no depiction of genitalia or explicit nudity.
Certain animations and expressions may include subtle flirtatious or suggestive elements, but the game contains no explicit sexual language or adult-oriented textual content.
The game does not feature any violence, blood/gore, sexual assault, drug use, or other mature themes.
